assets.prompt: Create one simple soft rectangular bed pillow viewed almost straight-on from the side, slightly squashed and gently irregular like a hand-cut political cartoon prop. Original limited cut-out cartoon illustration, bold charcoal outline, flat cream fabric with two or three subtle hand-drawn crease lines. Centered and isolated with crisp opaque edges. No text, logo, signature, watermark, characters, branding or imitation of a named artist or property.
edits: Generated output already contained an alpha channel and transparent corners; no chroma-key removal was applied.
Cropped transparent padding while preserving the intended display aspect ratio.
Downscaled from 1673 by 940 pixels to a 300 by 144 pixel prototype export for two-times display resolution.
Stored in the episode-owned presentation assets directory.
